role: The Ender Dragon's server-side behavior: construction with the seven EntityDragonPart constructor draws, onLivingUpdate's flight (target picking, turn, the 64-entry movement ring, part placement), wing push and head bite (against one probe player or through world hooks), block destruction, crystal healing and the nearest-crystal search, attackEntityFromPart, the 200-tick death with XP and the exit portal, and the End crystal's own tick and death.
gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
line 78-80, function enchantment_damage_roll: det_split_find by string, then det_split_random (calloc) on first use inside the tick
line 134-142, function set_target: do/while(1) rejection loop until the new target is over 10 blocks away (unbounded, as in Java setNewTarget)
line 112-115 and 359-362, functions player_bite and dragon_attack_part: knockback while loops that redraw Math.random until the offset is non-degenerate (unbounded, as in Java knockBack)
line 170-187, function update_parts: wing_push and head_bite are function-pointer hooks into the owning world
lines 429 and 439, function dragon_tick: spawn_xp callback; line 382, function dragon_crystal_attack: crystal_explode callback
line 457-468, function dragon_tick: nearest-crystal search walks the crystals array in index order (the order they were added, standing in for the world's entity list order)
notes: Line numbers in gpu are file lines of dragon.c. Crystals live in the dragon's fixed array (DRAGON_MAX_CRYSTALS 64). Without world hooks the dragon interacts with one probe player whose state is carried in dragon_state (player_x..player_rand). EntityEnderCrystal.onUpdate places fire under the crystal (block 51). Recordings: out/java/dragon (DragonProbe, test_dragon.c) and out/java/snapshots/end-arrival-s1, end-crystals-s1, end-dragon-s1, end-exit-s1 (DEVLOG 2026-09-25, the End in the whole-server replay). Not seen here: the client-side render interpolation and sounds (sound draws are consumed but no sound is made).
